shield: Use case: game-asset. One simple holographic sci-fi booster icon: a detached SpaceX Crew Dragon spacesuit HELMET, near frontal three-quarter view. Input 1 is the real SpaceX suit photo (NASA/SpaceX KSC-20180102-PH_SPX01_0010): use ONLY the astronaut helmet's smooth rounded shell, broad visor and neck ring, no person or spacecraft. Input 2 is the actual Tesla Jump game frame: compatibility reference for readability, NOT its paper texture. The user explicitly wants a simplified hologram style. Cyan luminous bold clean silhouette and visor outline, two or three translucent cyan planes, restrained narrow glow, sparse horizontal scan lines. Flat iconic geometry with a hint of depth. At 24px it must read immediately as a space helmet. Bright thick contours, dark transparent visor interior, no face, no logos, no text. No paper, sticker border, physical material, extraneous rings, stars or scenery. Entire centered helmet within square with 12% margin. Genuine alpha transparency, no background or ground shadow. Produce only this single icon.
speed: One Tesla Jump sci-fi booster icon, a simple holographic JETPACK, rear three-quarter view, no astronaut. Image 1: real NASA SAFER backpack photo, source for the compact back-mounted rectangular propulsion pack, paired side propulsion modules and shoulder attachment, simplify radically. Image 2: actual game frame for compatibility only. Image 3: approved new cyan hologram HELMET defines the icon family: luminous clean bold contours, sparse horizontal scan lines, a few translucent planes, restrained glow and no paper sticker border. Make the jetpack the SAME simplified holographic style in warm AMBER/ORANGE light, two short stylized exhaust flares below its twin propulsion pods to communicate speed. Just central pack and two pods, no tiny mechanical detail, no hoses or arms, no rocket/missile shape. Clear as a jetpack at 24px. Single centered entire object on genuine transparent alpha background with comfortable 12% margin. No badge, no circle, text, logos, stars, pedestal or scenery.
jump: Single simple Tesla Jump booster icon: an upright compression SPRING made of luminous LIME GREEN holographic light. Image1 is real Lee Spring compression springs product photography: use ONLY the recognizable upright coil form (choose one spring, 4 clear coils), no assortment or other objects. Image2 actual game screenshot compatibility only. Image3 new holographic helmet defines style, substitute lime/chartreuse for cyan: bold clean emissive contours, softly translucent planes, restrained narrow glow, very sparse horizontal scan lines. Minimal geometric spring silhouette, slight three-quarter view, wide gaps between 4 turns so it is instantly readable at 24px. No platform/base or arrow, no mechanical tiny details, no paper, sticker border or physical metal texture. Whole centered object on genuine transparent alpha background with 12% breathing margin. No circle, lettering, logos, stars, scenery or cast shadow.
life: Single Tesla Jump booster icon: a simple sci-fi backup microCHIP, replacing a heart icon. Image1 is the real Raspberry Pi RP2040 chip photograph: use the square package and peripheral contacts as geometry reference ONLY, no logo or writing. Image2 actual game frame compatibility only. Image3 cyan hologram helmet is the style reference: luminous clean bold outlines, minimal broad translucent planes, sparse horizontal scan lines, controlled glow. The chip glows vivid MAGENTA/PINK, square face almost frontal with slight three-quarter thickness, one inset square core and just THREE broad short pins per side, large negative gaps, immediately readable as a chip at 19–24px. Simplified futuristic silhouette, no circuit board, intricate traces, heart symbol, text, numbers, branding or pedestal. No paper or sticker border. One centered entire chip with 12% margin on genuine alpha transparency; no background, extra circles, scene, cast shadow or detached decoration.
score: A single simple game booster icon consisting ONLY of the exact bright GOLD text "х3", on genuine alpha transparency. Text verbatim: "х3" (lowercase Cyrillic х, visually an x, followed by digit 3). Nothing else. Bold clean geometric sci-fi sans serif lettering, two generously thick clear glyphs, bright pale golden emissive cores with narrow rich amber glow and a few very subtle scan lines, slightly translucent holographic light. Near frontal, no bevel or physical depth. Image1 is an actual Adafruit yellow LED display photograph: reference ONLY for luminous yellow light; do NOT reproduce device, segments, its numbers or rectangular panel. Image2 is actual Tesla Jump frame for contrast compatibility. Image3 is the new hologram helmet: keep the same crisp luminous holographic family, but gold. The exact simple lettering must dominate, read instantly at 24–32px. No coin, circle, token, frame, border, object, badge, platform, stars, sparkles, shadow, backdrop, additional characters or words. Center both glyphs together as a single compact icon with 12% margin, transparent negative space around and within glyphs.
